audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Irelia/Skill/Sion/Sion/Irelia/Sion/Sion. The packet and the mirror audit (irelia__sion, which flipped the same five rows) give Sion/Skill/Irelia/Irelia/Skill/Irelia/Sion.
audit.why: Every why argues the packet version: whys[0] is a Sion Level 1 before she has her stun, whys[2] and whys[3] hand her the Bladesurge-reset stage, whys[4] calls Level 6 parity, whys[5] is her Trinity Force spike. Five rows rendered the opposite of the paragraph beneath them.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Sion/Skill/Irelia/Irelia/Skill/Irelia/Sion in both layers as one group, ratings following the file's existing Sion-perspective convention (Sion/Skill 6/10, Irelia 3/10).

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2].why, phases[3].why and phases[5].why describe Sion-owned windows on rows that belong to Irelia — phases[5] says 'Heartsteel is your spike' on the row where the content layer says Trinity Force outpaces you.
audit.why: Her first item lands before yours pays off; your spike is the two-item row, which the chart already gives you.
audit.corrected: Three phase whys rewritten to their own sides, with Flawless Duet's 16s carried into phases[3].

audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate errors. (1) Ionian Fervor is said to 'shred your armor' in whys[3], wants.foe[0], mid and wants.you[1] — it does no such thing. (2) mid states Flawless Duet has an 18-second cooldown; it is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10. (3) The best interaction in the matchup is missing: Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage, and Soul Furnace's detonation is MAGIC.
audit.why: Riot's passive text: 'When Irelia strikes enemies with spells she gains stacking bonus Attack Speed. At maximum stacks she also gains bonus damage on hit.' No resistance reduction anywhere. And Riot's W text: 'She takes reduced physical damage during the charge' — so the one part of Sion's kit that goes straight through her charge is the W detonation, which the page never tells the player. 18 seconds is not any rank of any Irelia ability.
audit.corrected: Ionian Fervor restated as attack speed plus on-hit in whys[3] and wants.foe[0]; 16s in mid and phases[3]; the magic-versus-physical line written into wants.you[1]; Bladesurge's healing into wants.you[2]; Vanguard's Edge's 125s wall into spikes[2].

edits.before: Levels 4 through 5 are her strongest window: with Q resets, her passive at 5 stacks cuts through your armor, and her E sets a guaranteed stun that burns your W-shield on HER timing, not yours. Respect large minion waves entirely — do not try to fight on a 7-plus minion wave because she chains dashes and you can never complete a charge. At level 6 the lane rebalances slightly: your R can catch her mid-dash sequence and the sudden all-in threat forces her to play around your cooldowns. Hold your charged Q for the moment right after she uses E — Flawless Duet has an 18-second cooldown, and the gap between her E and its return is your only clean punish window.
edits.after: Levels 4 through 5 are her strongest window: with Q resets, her passive at max stacks adds bonus on-hit damage, and her E sets a guaranteed stun that burns your W-shield on HER timing, not yours. Respect large minion waves entirely — do not try to fight on a 7-plus minion wave because she chains dashes and you can never complete a charge. At level 6 the lane rebalances slightly: your R can catch her mid-dash sequence and the sudden all-in threat forces her to play around your cooldowns. Hold your charged Q for the moment right after she uses E — Flawless Duet has a 16-second cooldown, and the gap between her E and its return is your only clean punish window.

notes: The Ionian Fervor armour-shred claim appears in four fields and is not in Riot's text at all — the passive is attack speed plus on-hit damage at max stacks. I corrected whys[3], wants.foe[0] and mid; 'brawl through her passive shred' in wants.you[1] was replaced wholesale by the magic-versus-physical line, and 'your E shreds her lightly-armored frame' in late is Sion's own shred so it stands. The Soul Furnace detonation versus Defiant Dance interaction is the highest-value addition in this matchup and was absent: her W cuts physical damage during the charge, your W detonation is magic. Full-layer mojibake em dashes copied exactly in 'before', plain hyphens in 'after'. Note the file's rating convention leaves Skill and Sion rows both at 6/10; I kept it rather than introduce a third value mid-chart, since the group is validated atomically.
